PassiveDesc.Name: Speedy Delivery
PassiveDesc.Desc: At the End of Scene. At 10+ Courier Trunk, gain 1 Haste. At 20+ Courier Trunk, gain 1 Strength and 2 Haste. At 30 Courier Trunk, gain 2 Strength and 2 Haste

PassiveDesc.Name: Restoration Core
PassiveDesc.Desc: Upon taking what would be a lethal blow, nullify all incoming damage including what activated this passive, fully recover HP and move to next Phase (Max Phase: 3); at the end of the Scene this happens, fully restore Stagger Resist, Light and Draw 1 page. Unique BGM included.

PassiveDesc.Name: Phases
PassiveDesc.Desc: Phase 2 and Phase 3; 50% more Hp and Break. Has unique EGO pages and BGM.

PassiveDesc.Name: Blessing of the Light
PassiveDesc.Desc: At the start of each Scene, fully restore Light at a 50% chance

PassiveDesc.Name: Let's Get Fired Up
PassiveDesc.Desc: After dealing 10 or higher total damage in a Scene, restore 3 Light.

PassiveDesc.Name: Static Regeneration
PassiveDesc.Desc: If the character was not hit by any attacks for a Scene, recover 30 HP, 30 Stagger Resist and gain 3 Strength, 3 Protection, 3 Stagger Protection.

PassiveDesc.Name: HunterHax’s Prowess
PassiveDesc.Desc: When using a Combat Page, all dice on the page gain Power against targets with slower Speed. (+1 Power per 2 points of difference, up to 6)

PassiveDesc.Name: Barrier
PassiveDesc.Desc: Takes 50% less damage from all Ranged attacks. Reflects all Ranged attacks

PassiveDesc.Name: Counter Attack
PassiveDesc.Desc: Gain a Counter die with [On Hit] 50% chance to inflict 1 Strong Seal (Slash, 4-8) at combat start.

PassiveDesc.Name: Soul Harvester
PassiveDesc.Desc: Recover 25% HP and Stagger Resist upon defeating an enemy.
